Manipur Protests Demand NRC Before Census, CM Briefs Home Minister

Protests demanding the implementation of the National Register of Citizens (NRC) before the Census have intensified in Manipur, leading to a 48-hour strike that disrupted normal life in valley districts. Manipur Chief Minister N. Biren Singh stated he informed Union Home Minister Amit Shah about the people's demand for NRC before the Census. The protests and strike were called by groups advocating for the NRC implementation.
